# fabric_org_app_audience (Resource)

The Org App Audience resource allows you to manage a Fabric [Org App Audience](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/orgappaudience/items/create-org-app-audience).

-> This resource supports Service Principal authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notes:
# - The `definition` is required. The `parentAppId` in the definition must reference an existing Org App in the same workspace.
# - The `parentAppId` cannot be changed after creation. Use `lifecycle.replace_triggered_by` to recreate the Org App Audience when the parent Org App is replaced.
# - Deleting the parent Org App also deletes all of its Org App Audiences.
# - An Org App Audience cannot be moved to another folder on its own; changing `folder_id` forces a new resource to be created.
#   Moving the parent Org App also moves its Org App Audiences, so keep `folder_id` aligned with the parent to avoid replacement.

# Parent Org App
resource "fabric_org_app" "example" {
  display_name = "example"
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Example 1 - Item with definition bootstrapping only
resource "fabric_org_app_audience" "example" {
  display_name              = "example1"
  description               = "example with definition bootstrapping"
  workspace_id              = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  definition_update_enabled = false
  format                    = "Default"
  definition = {
    "definition.json" = {
      source = "${local.path}/definition.json.tmpl"
      tokens = {
        "ParentAppId"              = fabric_org_app.example.id
        "HasAccessToHiddenContent" = "false"
        "TabOrder"                 = "1"
      }
    }
  }

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [fabric_org_app.example.id]
  }
}

# Example 2 - Item with definition update when source or tokens changed
resource "fabric_org_app_audience" "example_definition_update" {
  display_name = "example2"
  description  = "example with definition update when source or tokens changed"
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  format       = "Default"
  definition = {
    "definition.json" = {
      source = "${local.path}/definition.json.tmpl"
      tokens = {
        "ParentAppId"              = fabric_org_app.example.id
        "HasAccessToHiddenContent" = "true"
        "TabOrder"                 = "2"
      }
    }
  }

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [fabric_org_app.example.id]
  }
}

# Example 3 - Item with custom tokens delimiter
resource "fabric_org_app_audience" "example_custom_delimiter" {
  display_name = "example3"
  description  = "example with custom tokens delimiter"
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  format       = "Default"
  definition = {
    "definition.json" = {
      source           = "${local.path}/definition-custom-delimiter.json.tmpl"
      tokens_delimiter = "<<>>"
      tokens = {
        "ParentAppId"              = fabric_org_app.example.id
        "HasAccessToHiddenContent" = "false"
        "TabOrder"                 = "3"
      }
    }
  }

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [fabric_org_app.example.id]
  }
}

# Example 4 - Item with parameters processing mode
resource "fabric_org_app_audience" "example_parameters" {
  display_name = "example4"
  description  = "example with parameters processing mode"
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  format       = "Default"
  definition = {
    "definition.json" = {
      source          = "${local.path}/definition.json"
      processing_mode = "Parameters"
      parameters = [
        {
          type  = "JsonPathReplace"
          find  = "$.parentAppId"
          value = fabric_org_app.example.id
        }
      ]
    }
  }

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [fabric_org_app.example.id]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (Attributes Map) Definition parts. Read more about [Org App Audience definition part paths](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/articles/item-management/definitions/orgappaudience-definition). Accepted path keys: **Default** format: `definition.json` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition))
- `display_name` (String) The Org App Audience display name.
- `format` (String) The Org App Audience format. Possible values: `Default`
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace ID.

### Optional

- `definition_update_enabled` (Boolean) Update definition on change of source content. Default: `true`.
- `description` (String) The Org App Audience description.
- `folder_id` (String) The Folder ID. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `tags` (Set of String) The set of tag IDs.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Org App Audience ID.

<a id="nestedatt--definition"></a>

### Nested Schema for `definition`

Required:

- `source` (String) Path to the file with source of the definition part.

The source content may include placeholders for token substitution. Use the dot with the token name `{{ .TokenName }}`.

Optional:

- `parameters` (Attributes Set) The set of parameters to be passed and processed in the source content. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--parameters))
- `processing_mode` (String) Processing mode of the tokens/parameters. Possible values: `GoTemplate`, `None`, `Parameters`. Default `GoTemplate`
- `tokens` (Map of String) A map of key/value pairs of tokens substitutes in the source.
- `tokens_delimiter` (String) The delimiter for the tokens in the source content. Possible values: `<<>>`, `@{}@`, `____`, `{{}}`. Default: `{{}}`

Read-Only:

- `source_content_sha256` (String) SHA256 of source's content of definition part.

<a id="nestedatt--definition--parameters"></a>

### Nested Schema for `definition.parameters`

Required:

- `find` (String) The find value of the parameter.
- `type` (String) Processing type of the parameters. Possible values: `JsonPathReplace`, `TextReplace`.
- `value` (String) The value of the parameter.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# terraform import fabric_org_app_audience.example "<WorkspaceID>/<OrgAppAudienceID>"
terraform import fabric_org_app_audience.example "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
```
